QuestInfo.name: Suri the Owl
QuestInfo.0: Lady Syl wants to talk to you about your new Job Advancement.
QuestInfo.1: It's time to test your new skills! Get some training from Suri, the owl in #bThe Secret Garden Basement#k. Suri uses word cards, since, uh, owls don't talk. Should be interesting!
QuestInfo.2: You met Suri. Quite an interesting creature, that one.

0.0: Practice what you've learned if you wish to become truly powerful. You will train here first, under the watchful eye of those I trust.

yes.0: #bSuri#k awaits in the Secret Garden Basement. Suri is an owl. The creature may not speak as you or I do, but trust me, it has more brains than you ever will.

no.0: It was not a request, young Dual Blade.

1.0: Hoot, whoooooot.\r\n#L0##b(You get the strangest feeling that the owl is judging you.)#l\n#k

npc.0: You will find #bSuri#k the Owl down in The Secret Garden Basement.
